text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—The Umamusume Quiz covers a wide range of 
questions, from past careers to personal 
obsessions. You could say it really tests 
the depth of your knowledge.
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of what Digitan and Trainer have 
in common... Isn't it the fact that you're 
both huge fans of Uma Musume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Still! It's always me who brings it up. 
I've never seen a Trainer getting all 
fired up..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And then! I finally realized it. The real 
reason is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that Digitan's presence is 
just too intense?! Could it be that being 
a loud-voiced otaku is intimidating 
them~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'm terribly sorry! I want you to be 
able to shout about how precious it is 
whenever and however you like too, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I wanna know what you love 
about your fave! And then I wanna squeal 
over them too!! I don't just want to be 
self-sufficient, I want us to share the 
love!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So here's what I thought! "If we do an 
Umamusume quiz, won't that warm up 
Trainer's shoulders too?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just to be clear, I have zero 
intention of flexing on you! Really, it's 
totally just for socializing!! Like one of 
those little feature updates Uma-tter does 
every now and then, ya know?!

In short, it seems she just wanted an 
excuse to have a fun chat about Umamusume 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright then! Let's get right into it! 
Here we go, everyone! Are you ready!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Popon! It's a two-choice quiz!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She makes you think she's so delicate that 
you have to protect her... but deep down! 
She's amazingly strong...! I luv her... 
Rice Shower-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Now about Rice-san!! Does she prefer 
rice or bread for breakfast?! Which is 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nowwww! Let all your Umamusume love, 
Trainer, EXPLODE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!! Too bad!! That's incorrect...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-Now, now~! Even the greatest minds make 
mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, what comes next is what's really 
important! Make sure you remember this 
before you head home today, okay?! Let's 
sink another step deeper into the hardcore 
fan rabbit hole!

...If I want to stand on equal footing 
with Agnes Digital, I should probably 
study Umamusume a lot more.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaa!! Bingo! You got it completely 
right!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When I saw her shyly blush and say, 'My 
name is Rice, but I'm eating bread'... I 
honestly ascended to heaven right then and 
there from the sheer preciousness, yes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant, Trainer! Truly splendid! Man, 
as your comrade, I couldn't be prouder!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well then, riding on that momentum, how 
about gushing about our faves!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Who's your current fave, Trainer!? Ah, 
sorry, let me rephrase that—saying 
"current" feels like I'm disrespecting all 
your past faves!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not that, rather, while loving everyone 
equally, there are times when one girl in 
particular catches your eye. Because the 
brilliance of Umamusume is—

...As a result of the pop quiz, Agnes 
Digital continued talking for a very long 
time.
